metadata.title: Committed Figures, Time-to-Parity, and make figures

story.iWant: every chart regenerable by one command and committed, with a chart that separates lost-the-price from lost-the-clock
story.soThat: the README and note show figures without running code and no figure goes stale silently
story.tasks: - Time-to-parity chart (AC: 1) - Figure script and manifest (AC: 2) - Make targets, guard, CI (AC: 3, 4, 7) - Regenerate, commit, document (AC: 5, 6) - Close out (AC: 7)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: See story file ACs 1–7. The guard design (source hashes, no pixel comparison, no sweeps in CI) is normative.

existing.reason: Add figures-check to the main job; figures-quick as a second job.
Sources on Seoul; regenerate if absent.

story-context.constraints: - No kernel/ or protocol/ changes; every scenario hash unchanged. - docs/figures/ holds PNGs + manifest.json + README.md only. - CI never runs a full sweep; figures-quick uses 2 seeds into a temp dir. - Time-to-parity is measured from run start (trough step + steps_to_first_band_entry), amended 2026-10-05. - Python 3.12-compatible.

interfaces.interface: sweep_spec_hash(spec_path: Path) -> str (sha256 hex of spec bytes + base content_hash)
exit 0 if every source_hash matches; else exit 1 listing stale figures

tests.standards: pytest; synthetic parquet for the chart; sweep_spec_hash changes when the spec or base changes; check_figures tested against a tmp manifest with one stale entry.
